boundaryCondition.description: A boundary condition of the adjoint scalar.
boundaryCondition.$comment: Factory: sources/adjoint/adjoint_scalar_pnpn_bc_fctry.f90:73-91 (no fallback). `dirichlet` and `neumann` are read by Neko's classes, so Neko's union is reused; its `user_dirichlet` and the other types are not factory cases here. Neko's union admits `user` only through its open fallback for registered types (any type outside its six built-ins, with `zone_indices`); the adjoint factory handles `user` itself, not through Neko's registry, so it is a branch of its own: that fallback shape narrowed to `user` and without `name` (the factory fills in `field_name`). Neko reads `name` only in its own scalar BC factory (neko src/scalar/scalar_pnpn_bc_fctry.f90:192), which the adjoint does not call, so the key is rejected on the Neko-reused branch (adjoint_scalar_pnpn_bc_fctry.f90:65-99 reads only `type` and `zone_indices`). The `user` branch is open, like Neko's user_dirichlet and user_neumann.

zone_indices.description: Zone indices, an array of JSON integers or the name of an integer array constant.
Zone indices, an array of JSON integers or the name of an integer array constant.

solver.description: Solver of the adjoint scalar. Each key that is absent here is read from `case.scalar.solver`.
solver.$comment: Neko's linear solver objects are open (registered Krylov types define their own keys), so this one is too. sources/adjoint/adjoint_scalar_scheme.f90:289-317,377-386.

type.description: Krylov solver type. Falls back to `case.scalar.solver.type`.

monitor.description: Monitor the solve. Default `case.scalar.solver.monitor`, else false.

adjointScalar.description: `case.adjoint_scalar`: the adjoint of the scalar transport equation (a single scalar).

enabled.description: Enable the adjoint scalar. Default true.

primal_name.description: Name of the primal scalar field; must equal `case.scalar.name`. Default `s`. With `name` absent the default adjoint name `<primal_name>_adj` must fit the same limit as `name`, so `primal_name` is at most 62 characters.

name.description: Name of the adjoint scalar. Default `<primal_name>_adj`. At most 66 characters and without `/` or blank (the log line and the checkpoint payload name abort otherwise: adjoint_scalar_scheme.f90:322, adjoint_scalar_pnpn.f90:264-266). While the adjoint scalar is enabled the schema rejects `abx1` and `abx2`, the scheme's own work fields, which the checkpoint payload registered under the adjoint name would list twice (a rule under `case` in the case-file schema).

advection.description: Advection of the adjoint scalar. Default true.

dealias_coupling_term.description: Dealias the coupling term of the adjoint momentum equation. Default `case.numerics.dealias`, else true.

boundary_conditions.description: Adjoint scalar boundary conditions; every labelled zone of the mesh needs exactly one.

initial_condition.description: Initial condition of the adjoint scalar (required; reset every design iteration).

allOf.$comment: adjoint_case.f90:333 and neko_ext.f90:438 abort on a `user` adjoint scalar initial condition.

adjoint_scalar_scheme.f90:322 writes 'Name       : ' (13 characters) // name into the 79-character log buffer (neko src/common/log.f90:46): a name over 66 characters gives 'End of record'; from 76 characters on, field_series lag names also collide. checkpoint_payload_validate_name aborts for a '/' in the name or a blank one (adjoint_scalar_pnpn.f90:264-268; neko src/common/checkpoint_payload.f90:165-170,600-605).
The default name is primal_name//'_adj' (adjoint_scalar_scheme.f90:282-286), which must also fit in 66 characters.
